projects.name: FFA Media
projects.status: v2 live · tap-a-goal pop-up and picker live on the Game results page · Acuity sign-ups lookup live (Who signed up button merged, not yet checked live)
projects.summary: v2 cutover (20 Oct) and native clips are recorded. The Monday Night League website feed is live with goal clips, a Goals tab and main/POV angles, and the clip player now has share, download and like (4 Nov), and from 4 Nov finished sessions are sent to the Match Log sheet from the app. API, real-device and deferred configuration checks stay open. On 7 Nov the game results page design (all sessions, list and calendar, mockup only) was agreed and a code check recorded; non-league sessions may optionally record teams and bibs. It will be a new page on the Squarespace site, fed by a public results feed. On 8 Nov the feed was built and merged, switched on, and the Game results page went live on the Squarespace site (not in the navigation yet): native title blocks plus one embed for the filters, list and calendar, checked at desktop, tablet and phone widths. Goals from the last 14 days in league games now open a clip player with share, download and like, as on the Monday League page. On 11 Nov normal sessions gained optional teams, bibs and goals (is_league flag) and league goals now reach the Match Log sheet automatically, with a Delete goal button. On 12 Nov multi-team days (2 to 5 teams, games logged afterwards from footage, one day table per session) were built and went live; goal claims with upvotes (players claim, others back, staff approve in the app) also went live the same day. On 12 Nov the player foundation began: player records and spelling aliases (step 1 of 3) are built, merged and migrated on production; step 2 (player ids on teams, goals and claims) is built and in review. Also on 12 Nov the Watch screen load error and the team, bib and goal buttons on normal sessions were fixed and checked in a real browser (phone not yet confirmed). Acuity sign-ups: the Acuity API is not on the current plan, so the app reads Acuity's calendar sync link instead; for Monday 9 Nov it found 28 people. Nothing from it is saved yet. On 13 Nov the website claim sheet was reworked: it asks the team first when unknown, handles own goals, has a quiet "Wrong scorer?" link and keyboard/scroll fixes (PRs 130-132); goals without a cut clip now show the match's YouTube frame and goal time and play the full match from the goal (PR 133). All live on the Game results page; no real claim tested on production yet; not checked on a real phone. On 14 Nov the tap-a-goal redesign (PRs 135 and 136) was merged: one pop-up for every goal (clip or match footage) with share, download, like and a More goals list, then a two-step player picker with public confirm votes, Undo and own goals. It is live on the Game results page. On 15 Nov a live audit found display problems and PR 141 fixed them (merged, embed re-pasted, live page checked at phone and desktop width): goals not yet sorted into teams show a goal count instead of 0–0, an empty multi-team day hides its table, the pop-up names teams by bib colour like the list, and two headings that were unreadable on dark are now white. Other audit items are still open. No real phone test yet. On 17 Nov Kris's clip-review requests went live (PRs 156 to 160): Keep and Bin, star ratings, rename, Ready to upload and Posted tabs, bigger Both-cameras Watch view. Review Both-cameras mode is also live (PR 161). Older March to August videos and a separate Ready to post step wait on Johnson's decision. Not tested on a real phone.

questions.text: What January date should the first player cards launch?
Should Regular require attendance in 8 of the last 12 weeks?
How many verified sessions before a player unlocks their first baby card?
After how many absent weeks should a player's card retire?
How should ties on monthly wins be broken?
Earn tiers by sessions played and never lose them?
Confirm wood to gold thresholds and the 500-hour wording?
Which format should power card flames on phones?

tasks.name: Verify attendance sources and deduplication rules

tasks.name: Define baby-card maturity, Regular status and permanent progression
tasks.note: Johnson confirmed full maturity equals Regular. The latest canonical direction uses bronze, silver and gold as the base progression, but thresholds and its relationship to baby/junior/Regular maturity remain unresolved. First baby card must be earned after several verified sessions, not the first attendance. Eight-tier ladder wood, stone, bronze, silver, gold, diamond, obsidian, legend: diamond 500, obsidian 750, legend 1,000 sessions confirmed; lower five thresholds are suggestions only. Suggestion awaiting decision: tiers earned by verified sessions and never lost.

tasks.name: Define temporary form and streak signals

Both colours mix dynamically. Three-goal stars, 4–5 goal lightning, 6+ goal crown last 48 hours. Actual verified event linkage and edge-case rules remain open.
